user.title: Connect your local Nest thermostat
user.description: For automatic setup, close this dialog and run `hearth onboard` on the computer connected to your Nest by USB. The installer reads its device ID and completes HA setup. [USB setup guide](https://github.com/tylxr59/Hearth/blob/main/docs/installation.md#automatic-usb-onboarding). For manual setup, choose HA's address on the thermostat's network and enter the USB-read device ID. Existing profiles are preserved.

error.profile_not_ready: The local commissioning profile is missing or invalid. Check the Hearth installation instructions.

init.title: Weather source
init.description: Use an existing Home Assistant weather entity. Optionally provide the thermostat postal code and two-letter country for its automatic-location fallback; Hearth does not perform IP geolocation.

error.weather_not_found: Choose an available Home Assistant weather entity.
error.weather_location_invalid: Provide both a valid postal code and a two-letter country, or leave both empty.
